summary: Per-rater significance scores were stored on 80 more counted records (63 copied from the earlier rater file, 17 scored by two fresh blind AI raters, one of which went to a third rater), bringing records with per-rater scores to 506 of 627. Recomputed over the counted set: weighted share in effect 18.1 percent (unweighted 18.3), weighted progress 30.2 (unweighted 30.1), centered bootstrap band 17.9 to 18.3 (raw percentiles 17.8 to 18.2), quadratic-weighted kappa between raters A and B of 0.82 (reach), 0.86 (magnitude), 0.85 (breadth), 0.89 (fiscal) and 0.91 (composite) on 506 records. No stage, score or weight on any record changed; the snapshot was refreshed.
title: Weekly significance recomputation
